trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.in_short: Earn all 54 other trophies in the single-player list; the Platinum then unlocks on its own.

steps.t: Work the list in roadmap order: story first, then the 100% checklist, then cleanup.
No online, DLC or difficulty-setting trophies exist, and one playthrough is enough.
Expect roughly 200 hours in total, most of it inside the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.in_short: Finish Gone Fishing, one of the first Chapter 1 missions; the trophy pops on its own.

steps.t: Start the story and play through the opening missions of Chapter 1.
Complete Gone Fishing — the trophy unlocks automatically at the end of the mission.
Story trophies cannot be missed, and there is no mission replay to fall back on.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.in_short: Finish Chapter 1; the trophy lands as the first mission of Chapter 2 begins.

steps.t: Play Chapter 1 through to its final mission.
Start What's in the Bag?, the first mission of Chapter 2 — the Chapter 1 trophy pops then.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.in_short: Finish Chapter 2; the trophy is awarded as Chapter 3 opens with Welcome to Vice City.

steps.t: Play Chapter 2 through to its final mission.
Begin Welcome to Vice City at the start of Chapter 3 — the Chapter 2 trophy pops then.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.in_short: Finish Chapter 3; the trophy lands after Chapter 4's first two missions.

steps.t: Play Chapter 3 through to its final mission.
Complete Ocean Beach and Another Life, the first two missions of Chapter 4 — the Chapter 3 trophy pops after them.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.in_short: Finish Chapter 4, closing with its final main mission, Starting From Zero.

steps.t: Play Chapter 4 through to its final mission, Starting From Zero.
Complete it — the Chapter 4 trophy unlocks automatically and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.in_short: Finish the story's final mission; free roam continues afterwards for all cleanup.

steps.t: Keep an untouched manual save from just before the final mission — there is no mission replay.
Complete the final mission; the Gold pops as the story ends.
Which chapter the game files that mission under is disputed — see the disagreements panel.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.in_short: Complete Breakfast Run, a Chapter 2 main mission; it unlocks as you play.

steps.t: Play into Chapter 2 and complete the main mission Breakfast Run.
Character switching opens around this point, which the later partner trophies rely on.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.in_short: Complete The Cartel Heist, a Chapter 3 main mission; automatic and unmissable.

steps.t: Play into Chapter 3 and complete the main mission The Cartel Heist.
The trophy unlocks during the mission and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.in_short: Complete Child's Play, a Chapter 4 main mission; automatic and unmissable.

steps.t: Play into Chapter 4 and complete the main mission Child's Play.
The trophy unlocks during the mission and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.in_short: Complete Headliners, a Chapter 4 main mission; automatic and unmissable.

steps.t: Play into Chapter 4 and complete the main mission Headliners.
The trophy unlocks during the mission and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.in_short: Complete VCIA Takedown, a Chapter 4 main mission; automatic and unmissable.

steps.t: Play into Chapter 4 and complete the main mission VCIA Takedown.
The trophy unlocks during the mission and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.in_short: Complete Operation Savage Glory, a Chapter 5 main mission; automatic story progress.

steps.t: Play into Chapter 5 and complete the main mission Operation Savage Glory.
The trophy unlocks during the mission and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.in_short: Complete the in-game 100% checklist — a forgiving subset, closer to 60% of everything.

steps.t: Finish the story; the checklist appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, and earlier progress already counts.
Clear the full-required sets: all robberies, 39 gang operations, 8 bank vaults, underwater discoveries, shooting-range golds, drone races and Bret's 15 Target Decks.
Reach the partial quotas: 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animals studied, 15 of 18 meditations.
Finish with 300 stunts and any 70 of the 80 challenges — ten challenges can be skipped.
Scan new vehicles with WAiNK and study animals through binoculars from the very start to avoid a late grind.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.in_short: Bank any 250 of the 397 stunts across four categories; under-bridge flights are quickest.

steps.t: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps.
Farm under-bridge flights first — they are the quickest category to complete.
Track progress under Progress > Activities > Stunts, or by name on the map's Exploration layer.
Keep going to 300 afterwards — the 100% checklist asks for more than the trophy.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.in_short: Sample all nine activity types once; most trigger naturally while you play.

steps.t: Try each of the nine activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball, an arcade game, a race win and a stunt.
Check what is still missing under Touchpad > Progress > Activities.
Most types trigger on their own during the story and the 100% run.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.in_short: Gold-medal every Shooting Range challenge — 42 golds in total across the ranges.

steps.t: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge — 42 golds in total.
Ranges also raise your Focus level, which feeds the Gunslinger trophy.
The 100% checklist needs all 42 as well, so none of this work is wasted.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.in_short: Win at least one Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations across Leonida.

steps.t: Win at least one Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations.
There are 42 drone races in all and the checklist wants every one, so finish each location while you are there.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.in_short: Win 20 different races; winning the same race twice does not add to the count.

steps.t: Win 20 different races — repeats of the same race do not count.
There are 40 unique races to choose from, and the 100% checklist raises the bar to 30 wins.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.in_short: Follow Cal's fishing questline after Chapter 1 and beat him in his own challenge.

steps.t: Meet Cal during the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui.
Wait for Cal's text — it marks a fishing spot with a purple icon on the map.
Follow his fishing questline through to the challenge and beat him in it.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.in_short: Finish any one of the four in-game arcade games, all of its levels, a single time.

steps.t: Pick any of the four arcade games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind or Bang For Your Buck.
The first three are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1; the fourth sits on arcade cabinets in the world.
Finish all of the game's levels once — its side challenges are not required.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.in_short: Run Andy's five Lucia-only quests from Chapter 3 through to Puff Puff Pass.

steps.t: Play as Lucia in Chapter 3; Andy's questline marks itself after her call, with a texted address in Belville.
Work through the five Andy quests in order, ending with Puff Puff Pass.
The chain stays available after the story if you miss the window.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.in_short: Dive all seven of Kenton's shipwreck treasure sets and return every haul to him.

steps.t: Start Kenton's line in Chapter 1 after Island Dreams; he calls and appears as the green KR icon in Key Lento.
Dive his purple chest markers at the shipwrecks and dig the treasure up with the metal detector.
Clear all 7 shipwreck sets, returning each haul to Kenton; track it under Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures.
Kenton goes quiet after Chapter 1 and returns during Chapter 2–3 — he is not missable.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.in_short: Finish Billy's five Mudclub jobs, from Thrillbillies to Hometown Heroes.

steps.t: Finish Coffee Break in Chapter 2; Billy's line is then marked at Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
Complete Billy's five jobs in order, ending with Hometown Heroes.
All five remain available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.in_short: Finish 8 qualifying stranger strands — only some questlines count toward the eight.

steps.t: Finish 8 qualifying stranger strands; confirmed counters include Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete.
Named character lines with their own trophies (Andy, Billy, Tyrone and others) do not count as strangers.
Run Yago's hourglass race the moment it appears in Chapter 3 — it is timed, and his strand still counts.
Check the trophy tracker in the trophy list after each strand to confirm it registered.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.in_short: Deliver all 16 sports cars on Randy's Wish List to his west Vice City garage.

steps.t: Finish Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS in Chapter 3 to unlock the Key Cloner and Randy's Wish List of 16 sports cars.
Scan high-end cars with WAiNK (hold Up) to check them against the list; hotel rows at Vice Beach and Ocean Beach are rich hunting.
Deliver each car to Randy's garage (green RK icon, west Vice City); clean deliveries pay more.
Track the list under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.in_short: As Jason, burn down Tyrone's synthetic labs until his final job, Spin On This, opens.

steps.t: As Jason, finish Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3; Tyrone's lab sites then appear as purple markers around Vice City.
Destroy the synthetic labs (Take Out Kitty Litter) until Tyrone offers his follow-up job.
Complete Spin On This (Shut Down the Labs) to unlock the trophy; the chain survives the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.in_short: Meditate at all 18 counted spots; the Chapter 1 balcony session is the one window that closes.

steps.t: Finish the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth, then be at Jason's house the next morning.
Find Lucia in the kitchen; when she says she is going to meditate, follow her out to the balcony.
Talk to her on the balcony and choose Accept — the session adds +1 to the counter but is not itself a marked spot.
Keep a Chapter 1 manual save until this trophy pops; whether the balcony session is strictly required is unconfirmed.
Meditate at every marked spot with both Jason and Lucia — one spot visited by both counts twice.
The final spot needs both leads playable together, which opens after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.
Track the count under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations; the 100% checklist needs only 15 of 18.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.in_short: Bret's hunting line is documented, but no consulted source confirms which animal unlocks this.

known.t: Bret Vogel's questline starts after Coffee Break in Chapter 2: he texts Jason and opens Veteran Hunted in Lummox County; the line is Jason-only.
His Target Decks send you after requested animals (purple map icons); the 100% checklist requires all 15 decks.
Bret hands you the Killtelligence SM-69 rifle on the first quest; a clean one-shot kill pays more but is not required.
PowerPyx and GTABase both state plainly that which animal triggers the trophy is still unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.in_short: Complete any 3 of the 18 Collectible Card sets — the trophy does not need them all.

steps.t: Complete any 3 of the 18 Collectible Card sets.
Watch each set's progress under the Collections section of the Progress menu.
The 100% checklist later asks for 15 sets, so early sets are not wasted work.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.in_short: WAiNK-scan any 100 of the marked locations: landmarks, curiosities, sculptures, tags.

steps.t: Scan WAiNK spots by holding Up, then R1, when the prompt appears.
Any 100 count, drawn from 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures and the No Flusher tags.
Scan as you travel — the 100% checklist wants the same 100, no more.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.in_short: Complete any 50 of the 80 Challenges; most finish passively while you play.

steps.t: Complete any 50 of the 80 Challenges.
Track them under Progress > Challenges; finished ones carry a tick in the corner.
Many complete passively during other trophies, and the checklist pushes you to 70 anyway.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.in_short: With your partner beside you, raise 4 stars and escape clear of the red heat zone.

steps.t: Wait until both leads can free-roam together after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.
Call your partner in (hold Right, press Triangle), then cause enough carnage to reach a 4-star Wanted Level.
Escape until you are clear of the red heat zone — leaving the flashing search area alone is not enough.
The train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County breaks both road pursuit and the helicopter.
Bank vault robberies hand out 4 stars automatically, so this often pops during Maximum Withdrawal work.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.in_short: Rob three shops in a row with your partner while the Wanted Level never drops.

steps.t: Partner up after Coffee Break, gear up with armor, sticky bombs and healing, then rob a first shop and keep the Wanted Level alive.
Chain two more shops back-to-back, staying in the flashing wanted state the whole time — not just the red heat zone.
The three north Vice City jewelry stores (open after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, Chapter 3) sit close together; loot the back-room safes too.
The pop can lag about 30 seconds after the third shop; rob a fourth if it stays silent.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.in_short: Discover 100 vehicles by WAiNK-scanning them — you never need to drive them.

steps.t: Discover vehicles by scanning them with the WAiNK app: hold Up, then hold R1 while looking at a vehicle.
Stand by a busy road and scan passing traffic; scanning is enough — driving them is not required.
Check totals under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles; the checklist later wants 200 of the 277 base models.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.in_short: Drop 5 enemies inside one Combat Focus activation; buff Focus and bring a rifle.

steps.t: Build Focus first: eat, drink or wash up at home; Adrenaline extends the effect.
Aim a firearm and press L3 + R3 to trigger Combat Focus; vulnerable spots light up while the purple bar drains.
Drop 5 enemies inside that single activation — an assault rifle against a gang operation's guards is the reliable setup.
Cops, soldiers and civilians do not appear to count; raising Focus toward level 4 via ranges and activities makes it easier.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.in_short: Steal a jet docked at a VCIA boarding bridge and fly about a kilometre clear.

steps.t: Go to VCIA and pick a large passenger jet docked at a boarding bridge — gates E3/E4 are the easy ones; planes parked on the airfield do not count.
Enter via the stairs door beside the bridge and go up to the cockpit.
Back the jet out to the runway, take off and fly roughly 1 km clear of the airport; the pop is delayed.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.in_short: Steal a Rhino tank at Mile Zero Air Station and take out enemies from inside it.

steps.t: Head to Mile Zero Air Station on the south-west island of Mariana County; the Rhinos sit at the south end of the base.
Get through the gate — or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance — and climb into a tank.
Engage enemies from inside the tank until the trophy pops; save before you go in.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.in_short: Slip in the back door with the Snap Gun, empty the safe, and leave unseen.

steps.t: Finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 to receive the Snap Gun and unlock jewelry store robberies.
At a store's locked back door, choose the Snap Gun prompt — kicking the door in trips the alarm.
Inside, find the note with the safe code, loot the safe, and disable the alarm and security footage in the back room.
Leave unseen; Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a proven target.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.in_short: Rob any 5 of the 8 large bank vaults and escape the 4-star heat each time.

steps.t: Complete the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is… — it teaches the vault routine and robs the first vault with you.
Tail a security van to its bank and slip into the vault while the guard has it open.
Hand one cash bag to your partner (hold Right) — the haul is too heavy to carry solo.
Escape the instant 4-star heat on a fast bike, then switch vehicles to go unrecognizable.
Buy further van tips from Yasmani for $10,000; any 5 of the 8 vaults earn the trophy, and each pays up to $205,000.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.in_short: Rob an armored truck — a bank vault job counts — and escape the heat zone.

steps.t: Any bank vault robbery also counts as robbing its armored truck: finish one and escape the red heat zone, or reach a Pay 'n' Spray.
For an earlier pop, box in a roaming armored truck near a bank, stick a sticky bomb on its rear doors and blow them open.
Sticky bombs are stocked at the back of Yasmani's shop once his Chapter 3 jobs are done.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.in_short: Unfog the entire map of Leonida; a plane sweep is the fastest way to clear it.

steps.t: Fully unfog the map of Leonida — every black patch has to be visited or overflown.
A plane is the fastest tool: sweep the remaining fog region by region until nothing is dark.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.in_short: Rob one Illegal Operation from each of the 9 gangs; 39 operations exist in total.

steps.t: Rob one Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs — 39 operations exist in total.
Operations carry yellow map icons once you are near them, and many are marked by story progress.
Track per-gang progress under Progress > Gangs; the checklist eventually wants all 39.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.in_short: Order an Apple Martini at the Ocean View Rooftop Bar and drink it by the bar.

steps.t: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach.
Buy an Apple Martini at the bar.
Drink it while standing next to the bar, with the view over the beach.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.in_short: Steal the blue Banshee from the south Vice City showroom and drive it out the window.

steps.t: Obtain the Key Cloner during Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS in Chapter 3 — the target car cannot be taken before that.
Go to the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and find the blue Banshee inside.
Hack into that specific Banshee with the Key Cloner.
Drive it straight forward and out through the showroom window; the trophy pops a little way down the street.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.in_short: Take all three key valuables from Kingpin Bowling, then lose the police.

steps.t: Target Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn — a gang operation first marked by the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling.
Bring sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation; you will need them for the safe.
Take the luxury watch from the south-east office and the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun from the north-east table.
Blow the safe in the north-east hallway office for the third valuable.
Escape the police to pop it; a missed valuable can be collected on a later visit — they do not all need one run.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.in_short: Max out Strength for both Jason and Lucia at the same time by training together.

steps.t: Wait for partner play after Coffee Break in Chapter 2, then call your partner in before training.
Buy a fitness club membership and work out — while you train, your partner trains alongside automatically.
Filter Map > Activities to find clubs; after the story you can also train at home.
Check both characters under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength until both sit at maximum.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.in_short: Log 500 actions that shift your Criminal Profile; it fills passively as you play.

steps.t: Turn on Criminal Profile notifications under Settings > UI > HUD Notifications to watch the count.
Play robberies and encounters normally — stealth finishes, incapacitations and kills all register as profile actions.
The trophy lands at 500 actions, usually without a dedicated grind.
Avoid pushing the profile to Irredeemable — that status is permanent and makes police far more aggressive.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.in_short: No consulted source gives a confirmed trigger for this hidden trophy; we print none.

known.t: The official description is only a hint: “Second time's the charm.”
PowerPyx lists the trigger as currently unknown, with an unproven guess tying it to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue.
KeenGamer, GTABase, GTA-Zone and eGamers all list the exact steps as unconfirmed.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.in_short: Find the night-time UFO encounter north-west of Starlet Motel and help its victim.

steps.t: Go solo, at night after 2 AM, to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County.
Look for a blinking car at the roadside; if it is absent, leave the area and return until it spawns.
Follow the path from the car into the woods toward the bright blue light in the sky.
Approach the UFO, speak with the woman it sets down, and walk her back to her car at the roadside.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.in_short: On a bike, kick 10 pedestrians with Square inside 60 seconds in a crowded area.

steps.t: Take any motorcycle or push bike into a crowded area such as Ocean Beach or central Vice City.
Ride past pedestrians and kick them with Square as you pass.
Land 10 kicks inside 60 seconds to unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.in_short: Launder a running total of $250,000 in Marked Bills through your fences.

steps.t: Finish Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) in Chapter 3 to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer for marked bills.
Rob banks and Payday Loans to collect marked bills.
Sell the bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most.
The $250,000 is a running total across all robberies; bank vaults, worth up to $205,000 each, fill it fastest once unlocked.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.in_short: Spend a cumulative $100,000 across all shops; guns, mods and tattoos burn fastest.

steps.t: Spend across any shops — the total is cumulative, not a single purchase.
Guns, car mods and tattoos use the total up fastest.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.in_short: Buy all 8 purchasable garages in the real-estate app — about $160,000 in total.

steps.t: Finish Daily Driver in Chapter 2; the Vice City Real Estate app is then installed on your phone.
Buy all 8 purchasable garages through the app — about $160,000 in total.
The 4 garages the story gives you do not count toward this trophy.
Fund it with robberies; the bigger Chapter 3–4 jobs pay best.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.in_short: Register 10 stolen vehicles through Moses and the Scooter Bros app on your phone.

steps.t: Finish the Chapter 2 mission Moses to install the Scooter Bros app and unlock Moses in Port Gellhorn.
Buy garage space first — each registered vehicle needs a parking spot.
Drive a stolen vehicle to Moses, choose Respray, then Register.
From Chapter 3, Pay 'n' Spray shops can also register cars carrying standard trackers; cheap cars and bikes keep the fees low.
